My name is Daniel Rodriguez. I'm a 26-year old content creator. I received my bachelor's degree in Athletic Training from the University of Miami. I completed a pre-med postbacc program at the University of Florida. And I am currently in my first year of medical school at The Dr. Kiran C. Patel College of Osteopathic Medicine at Nova Southeastern University. 

Instagram: https://instagram.com/theitsdanny?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y=
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@theitsdanny?_t=ZP-8yCGwVcWM7L&_r=1

Contact: contact@danielyt.com
